title: KU Alumni to celebrate 2026 Fred Ellsworth Medallion, Homecoming Award honorees
summary_en: The University of Kansas will announce the recipients of the 2026 Fred Ellsworth Medallion and the 2026 Homecoming Awards at the Oct. 24 football game. The honorees include alumni, volunteers, students and faculty recognized for their leadership, service and commitment to KU.
title_cn: KU Alumni to celebrate 2026 Fred Ellsworth Medallion, Homecoming Award honorees

title: ‘The Emperor of the Moon: A Farce’ showcases physical comedy, shares messages of love, longing, trickery
summary_en: This fall the University Theatre is staging a sci-fi rom-com by Aphra Behn, a 17th century writer whose success inspired a future generation of women authors. Performance, direction and design work by both undergraduate and graduate students shine in “The Emperor of the Moon: A Farce,” which has been brought forward in time to the 1950s.
title_cn: ‘The Emperor of the Moon: A Farce’ showcases physical comedy, shares messages of love, longing, trickery
